items.criterion: A paid order names a billing account that exists in killbill.
items.judgment: Place an order and look the account up by externalKey.

items.criterion: Two checkouts for the last unit make one paid order.
items.judgment: Race two checkouts for RDG-TRL-SFL at one unit and count the paid orders.

items.criterion: A repeated checkout key returns one order.
items.judgment: Submit one checkout_key twice and count the stored orders.

items.criterion: An ended sale reprices the cart at checkout.
items.judgment: End the sale, check out a sale-priced line and read the refusal and the retry.

items.criterion: A paid order writes lines, sale movements and an empty cart together.
items.judgment: Place an order and read the order, line and movement rows.

items.criterion: One confirmation email reaches the checkout address.
items.judgment: Place an order and count the Mailpit messages to its address.

items.criterion: Checkout totals match the worked examples.
items.judgment: Place the three worked carts and read their totals.

items.criterion: Owner endpoints deny a customer and a visitor.
items.judgment: Call each owner endpoint with a customer token and with none.

items.criterion: Another account's order reads like a missing one.
items.judgment: Read VS-100001 as customer2 and compare with a missing number.

items.criterion: The cart refuses units beyond the stock.
items.judgment: Add three of CTR-CAB-CSP and read the refusal.

items.criterion: Stock equals the sum of movements for every colourway.
items.judgment: Compare each served stock with the stored movement sum.

items.criterion: An unknown corporate account is refused.
items.judgment: Check out with an unknown corporate key and read the refusal.

items.criterion: An EUR corporate account is refused with the currency message.
items.judgment: Check out with orbit-acme and read the message.

items.criterion: Collections hold exactly the products their rules select.
items.judgment: List every rule collection and compare with the product table.

items.criterion: Collection sorts order as stated.
items.judgment: Read all products under each sort.

items.criterion: Search ranks titles before colourways.
items.judgment: Search coastal and meridian and read the order.

items.criterion: The seeded products match the table.
items.judgment: Read each product and compare with the table.

items.criterion: Seeded accounts sign in with the corpus password.
items.judgment: Sign in as each seeded account.

items.criterion: The health route answers ok.
items.judgment: Request /api/health.

items.criterion: Unknown addresses render the not-found page with its status.
items.judgment: Open an unknown address and read the status and heading.
